Hanse makes you a trader in the 13th Century. Your hometown is Lübeck – a well known German seaport. With a ship and some money you want to become mayor of Lübeck. For this you must open stores in other cities – for example Riga, Malmö or Nowgorod. Every town has a special good (wool, furs or honey). After returning to Lübeck you sell these goods for a variable price. In Lübeck is a dockyard. There you can buy new ships. In Lübeck is also a bank for taking a credit. After marrying a woman and becoming childs you have to buy a teacher for your kids. You can send your childs on a expedition to find new cities. But after your death one kid should be in Lübeck. Then this child take possession of your store. Sometimes you were attacked by pirates or another countries. Then you have to place your cannons on a small strategic map for a automatically fight.

The game ends after 250 years or when you become mayor of Lübeck or no child can take possession of your store.

144292.overview: Harald Hardtooth is a tooth with a face, arms, legs and a bowtie, armed with a tube of toothpaste. He must use this toothpaste to shoot all manner of bacteria enough times to kill (erode?) them. The levels are made up of a sequence of platforms, which run across most of the level. Harald Hardtooth can always jump up one level, or jump down as far as necessary to reach the next ledge under him without incurring damage, although falling off the bottom of the level costs you a life. Energy is lost through contact with the bacteria, and you have a limited supply of toothpaste, with a need to collect more as the game goes on. You can also collect enhanced weaponry such as double firing.

144301.overview:
Saturday - half past 3 p.m. Ideal soccer weather for soccer. The stadium is sold out. The fans are singing the team hymn. You're team is 2 points behind the leader. This is the match of the year for you and your team. The next 90 minutes will decide over success or failure. You have to win if your team want to be next year in the first division. The pressure is mighty. You have to calm your nerves.

You sit on the hottest seat in soccer. You are the manager of your favorite team and have to lead your the team from the amateur division into the European first class.

Hattrick! is another German soccer manager. There are two different modes. The serious and the funny one. The difference you see in the game newspaper reviews.

144302.overview:
Hostile All-Terrain Encounters await in this shoot 'em up notable for it's unusual diagonal scroll, which is similar to Costa Panayi's previous Highway Encounter series. As nobody is qualified to take the enemy on, your task is to complete the 30 levels of training (the actual war could've been the basis for a sequel, although this never happened).

The levels alternate between controlling a Star Fighter plane and a Ground Assault Vehicle; the latter is faster but is confined to ground motion. The plane can move up and down to make dodging the simulated enemy fire easier. This generally comes at you in waves, although there are also ground installations.

Central to the game is to shoot at the cases of plasma crystals, and then fly over these so as to carry them to the end of the level. Dying loses you one of these crystals if you have at least one, or a life if you do not. Completing a level with at least 2 crystals is effectively a restart point as well, as when you die you are sent back to a level in which you collected at least 2.

144303.overview: Heat Wave: Offshore Superboat Racing is a racing game in which the player uses a power boat to race against four AI opponents. There are various aspects to keep track of during a race, like avoiding overheating the motors or a steady adjustment of the trim. During the race it may be needed to stop and conduct repairs on the ship due to contact with the opponents or the environment. However, it is important that the player took repair parts and fuel (which can be chosen after the qualifying race) with them. There are six courses and an editor to create more.

144304.overview:
In a world called Boran, the evil sorcerer Kronos decides he has to put an end to King Aaron's rule. Aaron however is protected by the white mage Gandalf, who fights a terrible battle of magic against Kronos. At the end of the battle, both sorcerers are killed and Gandalf's staff is broken in two parts. Now Kronos' evil helper Hellowoon saw his chance at bringing the land under his control. He set up a reign of terror, but there was one more thing he needed: Zarrak, who is Aaron's son.

The player assumes Zarrak's role, and the game begins with Zarrak waking up in a prison cell, bound by a chain to the wall. Hellowoon is a text-adventure, so all actions are controlled by words entered into the parser. Each room does however have its own graphical representation at the top of the screen. During the course of the game, the player may learn a total of three magical spells that can be used to defend themselves against foes.

144305.overview:
Your SuperCobra assault helicopter is the most advanced of its kind, oozing with missiles and full of power, ready to blow everything in its path into the weeds. All it needs now is a capable pilot; hopefully you can fit the bill.

The action is spread over day and night levels, across different types of terrain. On each level you must destroy a set number of aircraft to move onto the next level - otherwise the level loops back to the start. Extra lives can be collected throughout, and your plane is armed with smart bombs to use when the action is especially hectic.

144306.overview:
Hexuma - Das Auge des Kal is interactive fiction with graphics and a point-and-click interface.

This German-only game is the last of three text adventures created by the Weltenschmiede team, the other two being Das Stundenglas and Die Kathedrale. Hexuma sends you into an old, supposedly haunted mansion, which turns out to be a gateway to six different periods in Earth’s history. Travel from the age of dinosaurs to the distant future and bring back six crystal shards to battle the sinister god Kal.

Otherwise a conventional text adventure in its design and functionality, Hexuma is aiming for the versatility record: the game knows six different ways to enter a command. You can simply type it in. You can click on objects in the graphic window to trigger the most probable action. You can piece your sentence together in an icon menu. You can consult a list of pre-fabricated commands tailored to the situation. You can click on any word in the text screen to copy it in the command bar. And, strangest of all, you can enter your command letter by letter with the mouse on a display of a keyboard. Talk about German diligence.

There are a few puzzle dead-ends, so you might consider saving frequently.

144311.overview:
The first of Phoenics' and Software 2000 Artventures series, Holiday Maker tells the story of four young people who decided to spend their vacation on an uninhabited island. Before long a series of strange events and accidents take place, so that the youths soon find themselves in the midst of a murder mystery.

This is an adventure game that utilizes digital pictures with live actors and photorealistic still backgrounds. The interaction with the game world is done via an icon-based interface.

144312.overview: Howzat! One Day International Cricket is an Amiga cricket sports game released in 1992 by Nightowl Software.

144313.overview: The next volume of Hoyle Book of Games features 28 Solitaire games: Calculation, 8 Off, Strategy, Shamrocks, Eagle Wing, Yukon, Beleaguered Castle, Eliminator, Klondike, Slide, Canfield, Bowling, Golf, Nestor, Flower Garden, Aces Up, Scorpion, Gaps, Spiderette, Penguin, La Belle Lucie, Pyramid, Fortress, Triplets, Baker's Dozen, Poker Square, Cribbage Square, Bristol.

144314.overview: With 20000 dollars in your pockets and a cinema with 5 movie rooms you are starting to make a great movie maker career. First you buy some old, real-named movies (for example Star Wars, Evil Dead, etc) for showing them in your cinema. You can fix the prices for the tickets individual. Each movie room can have up to 5 performances a day. When you earned enough money you can do some more interesting things. Producing your own movie. Either you buy a shooting script or you make your own one by clicking some pretended words and choosing a film genre. After this you must select some actors and a director for your forthcoming blockbuster. At least you look for the locality, special effects, film music and more things. After all your movie will be rated by a jury and earns (it is to be hoped) your capital for the next blockbuster.

144315.overview: Race at Incredible speeds on over twenty tracks on nine different planets around the universe. Complete in a league that contains the best hovercar racing championship.

144316.overview:
Play six different card games (Crazy Eights, Old Maid, Hearts, Gin Rummy, Cribbage, and Klondike Solitaire) against 0-3 computer opponents (as appropriate for each game).

There are 18 available computer opponents, including characters from other Sierra games (Colonel Henry Dijon, Shelly LeBlanc, Officer Sonny Bonds, Larry Laffer, King Graham, Roger Wilco and Princess Rosella), Sierra employees (Warren Schwader and Jerry Moore) and their children, and others. The different opponents play the different games at different skill levels, and are broken up into "Serious" and "Not-So-Serious" categories. All the opponents will taunt you (in character) as you play (though you can turn off in-game conversation if it's too distracting).

144317.overview: Hunter Killer is an Amiga simulation game released in 1990 by 16-Blitz.

144318.overview: Huey is an Amiga h-scrolling shoot'em up game released in 1989 by ECP.

151307.overview: An action game created by G. Gaspar, A. Bujtas and P. Nemecsek for the December 1992 Amiga Fun magazine coverdisk. Find all these "things" with your flying dragon before time runs out. Do not crash into the walls. Once you mark all the things an exit will open up.

151308.overview: In Highway Hawks the player controls a car with a mounted weapon. During each level, taking place on a long road, the goal is to reach the goal without dying. After each level the player can upgrade the car and its weapons with money which is earned by having a low finishing time and causing damage to other cars. Jumping over scaffolds gives a time bonus and shooting a truck may cause additional ammo to fall out. The fuel is limited and constantly drained during play, but extra fuel can be picked up on the way. The camera view is from behind the player's car.

151309.overview: Originally a published app, but eventually made freeware by author, Mark Sheeky. Hilt is an early rougelike game. The dungeon in the game is according to the game brief 50 levels deep! We can get a party up to four heroes of different classes and races.Please join me on this exploration.

153151.overview: Happy Monster is an Amiga single screen platformer game  developed by Harald Müller and published in 1994 by Schatztruhe. A cutesy platform game which will keep you busy and having fun for a while.

158269.overview: The alien race Hellraisers seized the planet Hazbal which is an important junction of space trade routes. The player's job is to drive them out of the system. The game consists of six levels with two alternating gameplay mechanics. In the first, third and fifth level the player controls the mercenary himself who walks and jumps through the side-scrolling levels. With his weapon he shoots everything that moves and uses teleporters and holes to find his way. The other levels are horizontally shooters in a top-down perspective. The player controls a space ship, moves through the levels and shoots everything that moves. Killed enemies may leave symbols behind which give advantages when picked up.

158270.overview: Originally a published game, but later made Public Domain by its creators. Translated to German in 2002 and released with extra levels. In it you control up to 6 characters who must venture through various worlds in order to destroy the enemy.  To do this you must solve puzzles and cunningly use your forces to outwit and outmaneuver your computer opponent. Each move consists of any combination of possible actions, such as walking, using computers, firing weapons and so on.

163771.overview:
In this game you are the pilot of a battle helicopter of the Federal Armed Forces of Germany (Deutsche Bundeswehr), who also produced the game. Your objective is to fly search and rescue missions and supporting missions in countries abroad. The perspective and gameplay slightly resemble that of similar games from the period, such as Electronic Arts' Strike series. 

There are no fighting missions in the game. Instead you save civilians from accidents, and natural disasters by picking them up by dropping food packets. Reflecting the legislation at the time,  the player gets to choose between a male and female copilot. If you choose the woman, the game will tell you that women can't become pilots, thus essentially forcing you to go with a man.

169325.overview: Scenario Disk for the modern naval battle simulator based on Larry Bond's popular Harpoon board-game from 1980. Brings 16 new naval scenarios for use with Harpoon, 3 main allignments of allies: East vs. West, West vs. Arab, Arabs vs. Israelis, Countries included: Egypt, France, Greece, Iraq, Israel, Italy, Libya, Syria, Turkey, US, USSR. Over 60 new platforms, including hydrofoils, helicopter cruisers, attack helicopters, German-type 209 Submarines, and Mirage Fighter Bombers.

169327.overview:
This release of Harpoon includes the original game and its Showdown in the North Atlantic BattleSet, as well as the second BattleSet, The North Atlantic Convoys.

The program itself is updated to support additional BattleSets (that were released later) and the Scenario Editor.

181258.overview:
The game tries to represent the 1st Harricana Snowmobile Race, which took place in Québec (Canada) in 1990 and patterned after the infamous Paris-Dakar rally. There are eleven stages with different visible horizons: Québec - Lac-Édouard - Saint-Gédéon Roberval - Lac Chigoubiche - Chibougamau - Rivière Broadback - Nemaska - Eastmain - Chisasibi - Poste-de-la-Baleine - Lac Wawa - Radisson.

Controlling the snowmobile in third-person behind view, the player should ride through a path marked with yellow flags in snow woods. Accelerating the snowmobile to move it forth and back is possible to avoid its blocking either by trees or debris in the snow. The direction of the way is shown also by the compass. When the way is lost, the player should find it as fast as possible. Other racers are present on the way during the day and night, and the last place on the stage means the end of game. So, the player should conquer the snows of Québec, show good time on each stage, and to be the first at the finish.

181259.overview: A game that's very similar to Boulder Dash - the basic idea of collecting things while avoiding being crushed is the same. The protagonist of the game is a dwarf named Mosiek, who decided to marry Rachel. A necessary condition, however, is showing the cunning and skill. He goes to a magical world in order to collect all the hearts. Assisting in completing the task are bombs and balloons, disturb stones and walls. In each level player must collect all the hearts, in order to open a door-portal to the next stage. The game features 64 levels.

181260.overview: Heliosfera is a space trade game with some action elements. Norton Axalar, saved from a certain death starts a new life in the Heliosphere star system with one small cargo spaceship. The player's task is to reach the ninth level of the merchant guild through the trade in raw materials on multiple planets. The game allows to take a loan, buy a bigger ship with a proper equipment, bet in the casino and repair the ship. Journey between planets is an arcade element of the game. On a side-scrolling mini game the ship must defeat all incoming enemies and reach the landing point. Failure means the end of the game. The game contains limited random events, such as bandits assault.

181261.overview: An educational and puzzle game that is a sequel to Scetlander's HOORAY TO HENRIETTA, which was released in 1990 for the Amiga. According to the box, HENRIETTA: BOOK OF SPELLS included a "Morgana the Morbid" colour badge.The game can be customised to use English words different to the ones supplied or words from foreign languages (see instructions below). High scores can be reset by deleting the 'scores.dat' file.

181262.overview:
The Hi-Tec Hanna-Barbera Cartoon Character Collection is a collection of the following games:

Hong Kong Phooey: No.1 Super Guy
Ruff and Reddy in the Space Adventure
Top Cat in Beverly Hills Cats
Yogi's Great Escape

181263.overview:
Hockey Pista simulates the sport of roller hockey. Matches are played on a single screen over a duration set by the player (for single matches). The human player always controls the skater closest to the ball and the goalkeeper at the same time, though the goalkeeper only moves sideways. The game offers single matches against the CPU or in 2-player mode, as well as a championship. The player's team name and colors are customizable.

An updated re-release of the game was sponsored by Italian professional player Franco Girardelli, then in Roller Monza. This version features minor graphical improvements, faster gameplay and a few other tweaks such as splitting matches into halves. The difficulty level is not selectable in this version. It is otherwise the same game as the non-sponsored version.

181264.overview: I don`t know the time, but it`s late. Seems like I've been walking these streets for ever. A sign up ahead reminds me that I`m still on Sunset. Sunset Boulevard, that legendary pathway that runs through the glamour and the sleaze, the dreams and the nightmares of Hollywood. As I stop at a street corner, the spicy aroma of Mexican food hits me from a late-night diner opposite. The depressing drone of Mariachi music mingles with the hum of a neon sign from a poker club next-door. A sudden gust of wind snatches at a letter in my hand.  It`s been one of those days, you know the sort i mean. I should`ve known from the moment I woke that today was going to be a bummer.. with a capital B! I switched on the radio to hear a warning that the Santa Anas were due to hit town. What was it that crown prince of L.A novelists Raymond Chandler said about times when those damned desert winds blow? "Anything can happen." And sure enough today it did... in spades!  I rolled into work like any normal day. I drive one of those goofy tour buses over at Universal Studios. Candy-striped contraptions, full of starry-eyed families from hometown USA and eager groups of oriental tourists pointing expensive cameras. "Okay folks, now we`re gonna relive that great scene from The Ten Commandments and cross the Red Sea...." Don`t ask me why, but today, instead of waiting as usual for the waters of the mechanized back lot sea to part, I drove straight on. Moments later, amid bizarre scenes of angry baptized passengers and water-spouting cameras, I was being dealt my cards. An instant career-move - farewell the land of Dreams and money, hello Welfare!  Armed with a final pay-check, I drove to my local bar and proceeded to get drunk. Still despite my bad luck, at least I knew that waiting for me at home was my faithful ever-loving babe, Barbie. With that uplifting thought, I downed a final beer and headed back to our apartment, a cheap but cheerful pad in one of Hollywood`s less glitzy neighborhoods. However, on arriving there was no sign of Barbie, only a folded note with my name on the front. Funny, no kisses. I opened it. The first words were something about being confused, the rest you can read between the lines! Like great philosophers throughout the ages, I sat and contemplated my life, the crumby state of my existence. Jobless, and now babeless! I had to start making some decisions, like cosmic and big. So I did, I hit the bottle again!  Just as the rye was running dry, there was a knock at the door. My heart skipped a beat. I thought, "it`s all been a mistake, she`s back." But no, it was just a repo man bearing yet more good news. Seems I was behind on my car. He gave me some papers and I gave him the keys. Considering how things were going, fair exchange I guess.  Anyway, back to my lonely street corner. With liquor-misted eyes, I look around at the glimmering lights of Hollywood, trapped like a moth in the even brighter flame of the surrounding metropolis of L.A.

181265.overview:
Holo-Squash is a futuristic sports game that is transmitted to its players through extra sensorial perception from a distant planet. Like in traditional squash it features two players in a enclosed court who take turns hitting a ball towards a wall. What's different is that the wall has two sets of eight circles and the players score points by hitting these. A match consists of three sets and the player with the highest score when all three have been played will win. In the first set the aim is to conquer more circles than the opponent. The second set works the same but now hitting an already conquered circle will give it away to the opponent. The third set is the most difficult and the aim is to conquer three circles.

The game can be played by one or two players. When playing alone the player will compete against three AI opponents in order, each new one harder than the previous one.

181266.overview: The Computerized Coloring Books is a collection of three games developed by Capstone Software and published by its parent company IntraCorp for both the DOS and Amiga systems. A port for the Windows 3.1 operating system was planned but never took place. The games are based on Bill Kroyer's film FernGully: The Last Rainforest, Don Bluth's film Rock-a-Doodle, and John Hughes's film Home Alone. The Rock-a-Doodle game was as released with Trolls and An American Tail: The Computer Adventures of Fievel and His Friends on the Capstone CD Game Kids Collection

181267.overview:
Based on German TV quiz game show, which was based on the US quiz show Sale of the Century.   With HOPP OR TOP we are presenting you for the first time with a computer game that not only contains original questions from the TV game show, but also includes the presenter himself...
Dear HOPP OR TOP fans, I was thrilled by the offer to write my own texts for this game. Because when I buy a game, I want to find what it says inside. So I spent a few nights enriching the studio atmosphere of this HOPP OR TOP computer version with atmospheric live lyrics. I always give my candidates in the studio the following tip before the show, which I would now like to recommend to you: "HOPP OR TOP is not an exam and we do not award grades. It is an intelligent game in which luck and speed are crucial. 

As a little bonus, I have hidden a few stories, anecdotes and stylistic highlights from my shows on this disk that were never broadcast.
I wish you interesting and enjoyable hours with our game. All the best and have fun!

181268.overview: Hotball is a soccer game which is played from a top-down perspective on a vertically scrolling field. A team consists of two athletes: a goalkeeper and a field player. The player can set the skill level, the athletes' names, the match duration and the used joystick. There are no throw-ins or corner balls.

181269.overview:
A compilation of three Amiga games from Hungary:

• Logic
• Zarcan
• Kid Pool

181270.overview: A game in the style of Moon patrol. Hurricane Commando is an Amiga h-scrolling shoot'em up game released in 1990 by Acro Systems.

181428.overview:
A microcomputer port of an old mainframe game, Head Coach simulates the NFL American football league from a dry manager's point of view, with a lot of text-heavy ANSI screens. Amiga/ST version 3 comes with player data for the 1991/1992 NFL season.

Each 40-minute match offers 26 offensive plays and 21 defensives. Use the strengths of individual players, based on continuously updated stats, to exploit the weaknesses of the opposing players. Running yards, passing yards, kick-off returns, punt returns and other statistics will reveal all there is to know about your team. As your players grow old, you can replace them using drafts from the college league.

181641.overview: Harpoon BattleSet 4: Indian Ocean / Persian Gulf (IOPG) was the last BattleSet published for the Amiga. It featured 16 scenarios (playable from both sides of the conflict), a new map of the Indian Ocean (Persian Gulf included), more ships, subs, aircraft (also stealth ones) and weapons (e.g. cruise missiles). New countries were added to support local conflicts (e.g. Iran vs. Iraq). While most Harpoon scenarios from that era were hypothetical NATO vs. USSR encounters, this BattleSet also featured historical mission based on 1991 Gulf War.

211069.overview:
In the mid 20th century, a spacecraft of unknown origin crashed in the town of Roswell, USA. A military cover up was initiated and the remaining evidence from the site was taken to a military airbase in New Mexico. The base was to become the major store of captured UFO technology and alien life forms.  
 
It was called the Delta Hanger, code named Hanger 18.

211082.overview:
Harold the Hairy Hermit is a platformer which involves the rescue of stray dalmatian puppies. Spanning five levels, each separated into three stages and a boss, the aim is to rescue the requisite number of puppies.

A demo originally appeared at the ECTS (European Computer Trade Show) and this one-disk version has been previously available. However, the game was not released and a mostly complete three disk version existed. This was in the possession of Nigel Critten, a programmer who had helped Rasputin with the A1200 and CD32 versions of Jetstrike and who was asked to look at Harold. It is thanks to Nigel that the disks survived.

This three disk version is still not 100% complete and has some issues; some levels crash and there is some level tile corruption.

211161.overview:
A shooter/platformer game for Amiga & Amiga emulators. I originally released this game in July 1993.

Hideous was originally named Sentinel and was inspired by the game Zamzara for Commodore 64. My most ambitious game to date, Sentinel took many months of work and was signed to a start-up publisher during development, but the publisher vanished overnight when the game was finished, so it was renamed and released as licenceware by 5th Dimension Software.

The game is generally joystick controlled and you have several weapons at your disposal: Space for smart bomb, right shift for missile, left shift for mine web, pull down and hold for death scream. Hideous struggles with  graphical glitches and appears to be most stable on v1.2 Amiga 500 systems.

211162.overview:
A very short game made in AMOS. There are only three to levels to play.

You can win by either win the race or destroy your opponent. I played one lap and then the destroyed the computer.

211163.overview: An overhead racing game developed by Impact Productions and released in 1995 for 1 to 4 players. A data disk with 6 additional tracks was available from Impact Productions

211554.overview:
Henry's House is a conversion from the Atari 8-bit version of the game. 

In this platformer, the player has to guide Henry through the numerous rooms of his house. Each room is a screen-sized level filled with deadly household-items such as toothbrushes, teapots, flying toast or coffee machines. Touching one of these objects or falling from too high kills Henry. The goal of each room is to reach the exit, however, before the exit opens up, Henry has to collect a key and all items that are spread throughout the level. In order for a key to appear, Henry usually has to collect a special item that sometimes adds more obstacles to a room.

211645.overview:
This action-puzzle game is reminiscent of Klax in both gameplay and perspective, but with balls instead of tiles. The objective is to ensure that colored marbles rolling from the far side are caught in the bins that match their color, if available. To do so, the player can place markers on every other row of the grid, which deviate the course of the ball. Points are gained upon guiding a ball to the matching bin, and lost if the color is wrong. Failing to catch a ball for which there is a matching bin will cost one life. Special multi-colored marbles can be directed to any bin, though missing them still costs a life.

The game is organized into levels, each with a set target score. Level progress affects factors such as the rolling speed of the marbles, the number of bins, and the appearance of random monsters which will interfere with player actions but can be shot off the grid.

211737.overview:
Another Snake game on Amiga Computers. HyperViper is accompanied by two sets of rounds. Simply rename the file "Viper-Rounds.2 to "Viper-Rounds" to play the alternative rounds. 
You can only use the included level editor if you registered the game.

211944.overview: This Shareware brain basher is a very good one for those who love logical puzzles. How do you get 1,000 drops of water to go where you want them to go, with only 4 blockers and 1 blocker remover? This is a bit like Lemmings but the water element means the drops are not controllable. The shareware version stops after level 8, but the full game has 33 levels.

212292.overview: Your mission is to free the kids that have been turned to stone, and get to the house on the hill to exit the game. Watch out for the bats, wraiths and pumpkins that have come to life. Pick up candy for bonus points too".

212455.overview: A maze game with a large labyrinth but a only small view of it. A lot of extras like moveable hindrances, pitfalls, keys, pearls and more in it, also a level editor to create own ones.

212456.overview: This flappy happy bat needs to get to his cave and loved ones, but someone put up all these pipes to avoid! Flap your flaps and avoid the pipes to get to your chiropteric family. Created in REDPILL.

212719.overview: Hillclimb is a motorcycle game for one to five players created by Bob Akerberg. You control your cycle with a joystick and take turns racing up the hill. With your winnings you can purchase better equipment to make your bike climb faster. You can set the number of races in the season, and the person with the highest winnings at the end of the season is the grand champion.

212720.overview: A Pac-Man style game with 5 levels to enjoy. It has tunnels like the original but also transporter pads called magic doors that can move you around the board. First extra life at 10k points, repeating every 5k afterwards.

213397.overview: A 1-4 player game by Christian Bjorkqvist of the group Software of Sweden in which you, playing as a frog, must eat all the bugs to feed your appetite.

213909.overview: A one player, 5 card draw poker game created in 1993 by L&M Magic Factory Group, originally the Happy Poker version was freeware with the Happy Poker Professional set to be paid, but it was converted to freeware, possibly before release. In it you get points from each good hand and try to improve your hand as you go.

213910.overview: Hardcore Bomberboy is a fast and frenetic freeware Bomberman-clone for 2-4 simultaneous players. The game has a built-in level-editor.  It was part of the Amiga Classix Gold compilation.

213911.overview:
Harry is a hedgehog and his job is to literally mess about with his balloons. Okay, so hedgehogs and balloons may not live next to each other in perfect harmony but, so what - it's only a computer game.  Harry's Balloons is a sporting challenge where the idea is to continually make decisions which have to be backed up by the skill of the joystick. In this game instead of popping balloons, you must stop them from popping and collect them up by color. Throughout the game you will also be awarded bonuses which range from magic disks and color worms.  
 
There are three modes of play, each one completely different to the next. You can have six players in the competition tournament which I suppose is a bit like a league. There's also the knockout tournament whereby every losing player is obviously eliminated, and finally there's the pick-a-round stage where you can choose your favourite stage.

213912.overview: One of the Haunted Mine series of six games by Skippy, created in 1994 and released by the Emerald Mines Club of Australia. The game is a Boulder Dash\Emerald Mine type game where you collect the emeralds, defy the brain-taxing obstacles and reach the exit, all before the time runs out. The game contains many levels from the simple to the nearly impossible, all for one or two players.

213913.overview: As released in the 50 Great Games compilation and was part of the CU Amiga coverdisk in November 1991.  It is fairly simple Arkanoid/Breakout clone created by a certain Matt Rutter.

213914.overview: A trick avoiding card game created by Mark Slone and released in Assassins Disk 218.  It is named after its highest penalty card, the Queen of Spades or "Black Lady". It is a trick-avoidance game in which the aim is to avoid taking tricks containing hearts or the Black Lady. It is essentially Hearts with the addition of the queen of spades as a minus card, counting thirteen.

213916.overview: A clone by Markus Pohlman of the C64 classic Space Taxi with basic visuals and sounds. The faster you deliver passengers to their designated platforms, the more Deutschmark (DM) you earn. You also need to keep track of the remaining fuel in the tank of your hover taxi.

213917.overview:
Based on the movie of the same name. The twin brother of Shinobi has been murdered, Shinobi seeks revenge against Dragon the Killer. But Dragon wields the entity sword and a legion of cutthroats, but a ninja is scared of nothing. This ninja action fighting game for 2 players offers a breathtaking ninja fight at first with complicated fighting techniques. After that it works into a first person maze. More missions follow. 

 We suggest that the more experienced player plays with Shinobi, although it may be hard to learn the moves for a beginner. This is because the levels are becoming harder and harder the further you get. We also suggest that both players play with a joystick just to be fair, especially the "Rämpytys" level.

213918.overview:
An Asteroids clone with a flavor of its own. Every level the asteroids are a different color, it is unknown if it cycles back after 4096 or not. It was created by J. R. Parsison in on April 28, 1991. The object of the Game is to shoot the Ateroids what surround you, each time you do, they split into smaller peices and fly off in different directions, until the smallest peices what you shoot disappear and vanish

There are occasionally Flying Saucers which will come on screen, these will give you extra points if shot dead

As each new level begins, the Asteroids change colour and more of them appear, and the Flying Saucers will also fire much quicker as they enter the screen

213919.overview: A ROM hack of the original "Henry in Panic" game with a major increase of difficulty and some other nice or horrific surprises, depending on your perspective. Avoid a fall, do not touch enemies. Collect all out of 220 items in the game. Once you have died 20 times, the game will end. When underwater you will see Henry's number reduce, if it gets to zero you just drowned Henry! Each tower has a number of items and difficulty, some like Tower 1, the Ice Tower feature "Ultra Hell" difficulty. Remember, ice can be broken if you land in it and icicles are not your friend! You must get past the ruler of this tower, he guards the teleporter. Precision jumping is required. Each Tower will have a similar set up, though one or two aren't as difficult. If you can't get past the original Henry in Panic game, don't even try...that is unless you want to get taken down a peg or two.

213921.overview: A Jet Set Willy style platform game by Kim Byrresen, winning the game gets you access to the level editor. Henry is a little man who had a problem. Last weekend he was so friendly, he held a part for all his buddies, but being a little drunk the place became a mess. When he woke up and shook off most of the hangover he realized he was going to have to clean the place up alone. But his head is pounding so he also needs food...badly!! Your mission is to help Henry clean up and eat some food so his headache will lessen.

213922.overview: A single person, multi-screen platfomer created by Matti Niskanen aka Matt Kane. Created with the Sparrow engine.  Navigate the platforms and ladders to get all the gold nuggets, avoid or engage in hand to hand combat with any enemies you find there. Falling too far will use up your health meter, finding health packs will increase it.

213923.overview: A Boulder Dash style maze and collect'em-up game created by Paul Thompson and released in 1996 as Shareware.

213924.overview: A single player, commercial Galaxians clone developed by Jens Meggers, Michael Goeckel and Thomas Sikora of Twilight Zone Software and released in 1987.

213935.overview: Welcome to Seasons Classic's first C64 conversion, High Noon. Original game by Ocean Software in 1983. Original authors unknown. All code and music/sfx by Lloyd Rosen! of Seasons Classic. Features TWO PLAYER SIMULTANEOUS mode and high score saving!

213936.overview: A puzzle game by Harald Müller (Mueller) that was released commercially in 1995 and later published in the Gamers' Delight 2 compilation.

213937.overview: Hit Puzzle is a simple puzzle game where you shoot a ball down the screen and try to match 3 vertically, diagonally or horizontally.

213938.overview: HIT TILES 2 SPECIAL EDITION is a game based on the well-known oriental game called Shanghai. It consists of 15 levels, each one featuring a screen made up of 120 tiles placed in piles up to 4 high. In every screen there are 4 of each tile. The aim of the game is to remove all of the tiles from the screen. The main and only rule you have to keep in mind is this: You can only remove 2 matching\linked tiles at a time ad both must have an empty place on either the left or the right hand side. Game includes IFF to Tile program to make new tile sets. Full version V1.1 Released on Aminet in game/think. More tile sets on aminet. Tile sets from old versions of Hit Tiles also work.

213939.overview: Gotta keep hopping, these lilly pads shift and sink into the pond. Avoid the crabs who are trying to get you. hopping on the pads by the grass will let you turn them into lilly pads and open up more areas, but be careful not to end up in the water. Try to make your way safely to the other side where you can dump your competitor in the drink and win!

213940.overview: A logic puzzle game by Joe Rumsey, this homebrew game is listed as unfinished. In this platform/puzzle game you prepare the way for balloons to make their way out of a difficult environment. Sort of a direct action lemmings game.

213945.overview: A two player, head-to-head Tetris clone that supported both the Amiga mouse and joystick as well as keyboard controls. The game was created by J.P. Hamilton and released as shareware in 1993.

213946.overview: A Columns clone With added complexity in the type of items to match. Created by Robert Lake and released in 1996 as freeware.

213947.overview: A game for up to 4 players that is similar to Monopoly, created by Ronnie Simpson in 1992. The object of the tame is to try to gain total control of the board. This is achieved by buying and upgrading the various hotels The computer keeps track of all the bank balances and transactions. Hotels are grouped in pairs and cannot be upgraded unless owned by the same player. The hotels become more expensive as you move clockwise from Go. The ones at the very center are the most expensive. If you bank balance falls into the red, the least expensive will automatically be sold off. If you are playing to a time limit, this is reached and all properties sold off for original values including upgrades to get the final totals. The winner is the one who bankrupts the others or has the most money when the time limit is reached

213948.overview:
The game is the old and well-known boat game, where we can face the computer or another player. Our mission is to locate all the adversary's ships and destroy them before he succeeds. We have three shots, but every time we manage to hit the position of one of the enemy ships, we will have an extra shot.

At the beginning of the game, we will place the ships on the game board horizontally, vertically or diagonally, knowing that it is not allowed to place one ship next to another, that is, there must always be at least one free square between ship and ship. There are 4-piece ships, 3-piece ships, 2-piece ships, and 1-piece Submarines.

213950.overview: Hydacorn is a timed puzzle-board game. The screen is divided into three windows. First one is a working window, the second one shows a pattern that must be arranged in the window next to it before time runs out, the third one explains blocks change sequence. Using fire the player may change the block accordance with the indicated order. Change can't be reversed. The block may be changed by placing the black box next to it. Each block covered by a black box moves to the arrival place of the black box.

213951.overview: This is art. An unforgettable experience. A combination of pumping techno beats, psychedelic visuals, and challenging gameplay that will keep you glued to the screen. Released on Amiga Action No. 63, Disk 3. An updated version (Special Edition) was released as Freeware in 2010 by the author. HydroZone is a first person runner game, with the camera constantly moving forward through vast tunnels full of obstacles that the player must avoid. The controls are basic, with the player being able to move the camera left, right, up and down to dodge past brightly coloured blocks, and using the control button to shoot, when needed. Hitting the blocks reduces your energy bar, and colliding with the blocks enough times ends the game.

213952.overview: A sequel\improvement of Wooden Ball. There are 3 game areas and to score you must hit the ball into the goal in the score area. If the ball hits your opponents wall you can stop the ball by pressing fire. If your GameCar touches your opponents goal you will be teleported to your side. By taking the ControlSign you will also control the ball, but if your opponent hits you, you lose control. If you choose Control Goal from the menu, you control your opponents goal in the score area. You set the difference in goals to allow a win. Released as part of the Nordlicht Spiele-Pack 4.

213956.overview: A conversion of the Tetris available on the MSX2 computer by Eugenio Favaro and Mirko Benedettini, released in December 1994, with updates thereafter. There are 5 rounds across four stages of play and all the standard Tetris goodies including next piece preview. The backgrounds include the beautiful vistas of Italy.

213957.overview: Hextris is a Tetris clone that was one of the many of this type of Amiga game to introduce hexagonal (beehive-shaped) blocks as the name suggests. The edges of the playing area are also hexagonal-shaped to fit the blocks. The game is more difficult as a result, since there are many more exposed edges that must fit with other tiles - five as opposed to three in a normal Tetris game. This version is by Ives Aerts and came out in 1992 and was for one or two players.

213958.overview: Highflyer is a six player Air combat Game. Six players can play simultaneously on one computer. The game was created by Nikki Corruptions and released in November of 1992. Up to four players can play on the keyboard, multiple joysticks supported. Shoot your mates and gather POW packets to get extra and upgraded weapons.

213959.overview: A puzzle game. Draw a line to direct the ball to collect the items and then return home. Released as freeware in the Arktis Edition compilation disk in 1994. Created by R. Schneider and S. Schröder in 1993.

213960.overview: A head to head Tetris without the usual tetromino shapes, preferring instead to use TMX chips, big and small brains and other objects to really fry your brainpan. Tetris clones with a high level of motivation. Species falling from above (from the chip to the cerebrum) must be brought into a row. With 2 player mode and lots of extras!

213977.overview:
Hex is a turn-based strategy game, played out on a grid of hexagons, each linked to up to 5 other tiles. You face one or two of the 12 computer opponents (various animals including a jellyfish, a dodo, and a morphing elemental character) depending on the level, each of whom claims a colour, and aims to step on every square to turn in their colour a lá Q*Bert. Whenever a tile is touching another of the same colour, those tiles become linked (think in terms of how a country forms an alliance with another), and you must activate them all to see any difference.

The game rewards successful completion of levels by offering spells, ranging from faster movement to position swapping to 'confuse' sells which change the colour the squares appear in. These are selected form a drop-down menu using the mouse.

214892.overview:
An educational games collection from F1Software, created by Dean Wood and released in 1997. Introducing  HERMAN  and his collection of fun and educational games. This game is designed to run from RAM, so anyone with a standard A1200 can take a  peek  at the program.  The full version can ONLY be run from hard drive, so remember that this is just for fun. The full version has a total of 10 games, the demo only has 2.  
 
GAME 1
PICTURE PUZZLE (NOT AVAILABLE ON THE DEMO)
With this game you start off with a Full screen size Picture that is mixed
up, there is a box with the picture in it to show you what the complete
picture should look like just move that box around to make the picture the
same as the one in the box.
If you want to load a different picture then just press the right mouse button
and a selector will appear, here you could select a picture or exit to either
Hermans Adventures or the Menu System.

GAME 2
CARDS (NOT AVAILABLE ON THE DEMO)
With this game you are given so much money in the bank, select how much you want
to bet with and then just press High or Low to the card thats there, EG -
5 Hearts you could press High hoping for a higher card.
There's not much else to say about this game just play it and see how much fun
you can have.

GAME 3
NAUGHTS AND CROSSES (NOT AVAILABLE ON THE DEMO)
This game has been around for a long time, you should know this one but if not here
goes, you play against Herman taking it in turns to place either a cross or
nought in the playing area, if you can get a three placement line you win.

GAME 4
MUSIC (NOT AVAILABLE ON THE DEMO)
If you like music this is for you, you get a keyboard to play samples from with
or with-out music.
There's five music tracks to select from and 25 samples, with the samples you
can play them up or down in speed, so select say track 3 and sample Mushy Mushy
then play your sample from the keyboard to the beat of the music track.

GAME 5
MATCH-IT (NOT AVAILABLE ON THE DEMO)
With this game you use the arrow keys to move Herman to the word then press
the return key then move the word to the picture that matches the word.
The only way to get out of this game is to complete a level and then you will
get a selection box come onto the screen, then using the space bar you can either
exit or carry on.

GAME 6
COUNTING (THIS IS AVAILABLE ON THE DEMO)
This game is fun, you are asked how many EG - Hermans are there, you count the
Hermans and enter your selected number and press return if you get it right you
carry on if not you are shown how many there are then you carry on from a new
display, again as with Game 5 the only way out it to complete a level and the you
will get a selection box come onto the screen, the using the space bar you can
either exit or carry on.

214893.overview: Highway Sprint was developed by a team of people such as Erik Hogan, Koyot1122 and Simone Bernacchia. Looked to feature non stop racing fun as you race along a road at dangerous speeds while also trying not to crash into other cars. You can set the number of AI drivers, but the speed has been turned down to make things a little less frustrating and to let you deal with more turns and added curves.

215067.overview: In this game you play the role of a detective who is hunting murderers in a hotel. The gameplay involves you moving down the corridor and waiting for the doors to open to see if the killer is hiding in there. The mouse is used to control the crosshairs and holding down the right mouse button combined with moving the mouse left or right will move you along the corridor. There is a symbol at the bottom right of the screen which roughly guides you to where the killer is hiding but you have to be sure it’s the killer as if you shoot an innocent hotel guest you will lose a life. Time is also ticking away so you have to be quick in finding the killer.

215239.overview: Published in F1 Licenceware CD-Rom Volume One F1-001 To F1-100, this AMOS based platfomer by State of the Art was released in 1995. Game came with source code included on disk1. As Henry, you have been ordered to collect all of your toys which are scattered in various rooms of the house. If you cannot, no allowance\pocket money for you! To select a level, guide Henry to a door then press fire to open it. Each level has a time limit, collect all the items within this time limit and a secret entrance will open.

217018.overview:
Some would call it a HotShot clone, the creator of the game, Chris Nash, said the game was created because of a  little old Spectrum game of the name `HotShot'.  I loved it so  much that I  wanted to play  it again, but the old Spectrum is broken  and I  can't find it for the Amiga...so i wrote it.  
 
In one sentence I would describe HotShots  as a cross between Pinball and Arkanoid. The idea  is to get  as many points per round  by hitting the bricks at the  top of the screen  with the ball,  and  try to  stop your opponent from doing the same,  on there side of the screen. Just one ball for the two of you, and you can try to gain possession with your Graviton guns, pressing fire makes the gun pull at the ball,  until it is stuck to the end ( You can only hold it for a limited time).  You can then let go, and the ball shoots off  in the direction your facing,  hopefully hitting bricks for points.  If the ball hits your character at any speed then you will loose a bit of energy, lose too much and your opponent wins.

217069.overview:
This is a four game compilation featuring games with quite diverse fighting heroes in the range from James Bond to Luke Skywalker:

   ◉ Barbarian II (Axe of Rage)
   ◉ License to Kill
   ◉ The Running Man
   ◉ Star Wars

218311.overview: The Hanna-Barbera Animation Workshop for Commodore Amiga from Empire on Disk. 1994 cartoon animation package that works on all Amigas.

218714.overview: Hoser Backgammon is an simple Amiga Shareware version of the classic board game of the same name. It can only be played against the AI and is controlled with the mouse: to move a checker, click on it with the left mouse button, then click on the spike that you want to move the checker. If a move is invalid, an error message will be displayed in the menu stripe.

218949.overview:
The medieval land of Parthoris is swept by a mysterious plague. Its infected inhabitants descend into madness. Corvus, the protagonist of the first Heretic, finds a way to escape from his home town, but is still contaminated by the plague. Since he possesses one of the ancient Tomes of Power, he is not immediately affected by the plague; but sooner or later, he will have to succumb to it. Before that happens, Corvus must find who or what was causing the plague in the first place...

Heretic II is a third-person fantasy shooter game with the camera chasing behind the character. The perspective is pretty much the only thing that breaks with the tradition of the series. The core gameplay still consists mainly of exploring the large fantasy-themed levels, using medieval weapons (mainly long-ranged) and spells to deal with the plethora of enemies. Despite the third-person view, jumping and environmental puzzles are used as moderately as it is usual in first-person shooters.

219330.overview: Hibernated 1 - This Place is Death (Director's Cut) is an Infocom style interactive fiction game. It's a complete rewrite of the classic, award-winning Hibernated game using Infocom's Z-machine standard, with tons of additional narrative content and riddles. If Infocom had been asked to recreate the classic Hibernated, the Director's Cut would have been the outcome. Like the initial version you can  journey far beyond the known regions of the universe? Close to Alpha Centauri, Olivia Lund is on the trail of one of mankind's greatest secrets and a thousand-year-old mystery. After nearly 20 years in hypersleep, she wakes up alone on her stranded ship, the Polaris-7. The artificial intelligence Io seems to be her only remaining friend now.

219331.overview: A wonderful infocom style text adventure from Stefan Vogt and released by Pond Software in 2018. You can even buy it along with the director's cut release for the same, self-set price! Have you ever dreamed about a journey far beyond the known regions of the universe? Close to Alpha Centauri, Olivia Lund is on the trail of one of mankind's greatest secrets and a thousand-year-old mystery. After nearly 20 years in hypersleep, she wakes up alone on her stranded ship, the Polaris-7. The artificial intelligence Io seems to be her only remaining friend now.

417662.overview:
Herewith the Clues is a detective game based on the 1939 "Crime Dossier" of the same name, originally devised by Dennis Wheatley (1897-1977) and J.G. Links (1904-1997). While the original format devised by Wheatley and Links was a cardboard folder full of physical documents and replica clues such as cigarette ends, movie ticket stubs, locks of hair, newspaper clippings, etc., this video game adaptation uses black and white digitized photographs of the clues and presents them laid out on a desk to be inspected and looked through using a point & click interface.

The crime you are trying to solve is the murder of a Russian man named Serge Orloff, who had been living in London and running a club called The Milky Way.

417946.overview: Typical British weather... it is raining and starting to flood. Hep save the rabbit from drowning by jumping higher and higher while eating as many chocolate eggs as possible which will give you more energy for jumping!

418349.overview: A text only adventure from Estrup, Cybersonik and Mount of Cultural Productions with music from Chromag! It begins on a day not unlike so many others. In fact it was afternoon. You were sitting in your dark and slightly evil-smelling small office with the feet solidly planted on my desk. Outside it was raining and 6 degrees in the shade. OK, it was actually 6 degrees everywhere since the sun wasn't shining and it hadn't done so for long. It was actually also a long time ago you had had your last case. Exactly how long ago you couldn't remember but since then a very complicated system of spider's web had been made at the front of your archives. 418665.overview:
An open source conversion of the DOS\Acorn RISC PC versions to Amiga by Raven Software. As in the original, the world has been attacked by the three Serpent Riders from the Abyss. Their mysterious power makes people obey and follow them like sheep. Only the ancient Sidhe elves are immune to the Riders' influence, which led to them being branded heretics. With most of their work done, the two elder Riders leave, leaving only D'Sparil, the youngest and weakest Rider, behind to oversee the oppression. He sends the armies of the Seven Kings against the Sidhe, who have no choice but to extinguish the Seven Candles, vanquishing the armies. The retribution is swift and hard, and most of the elves are destroyed. Now, one of the last remaining Sidhe must take the fight to D'Sparil himself, being the only hope his world has left.

Heretic is the first game in the Heretic / Hexen franchise. It uses the engine from id Software's DOOM and transplants that game's first person shooter gameplay into a fantasy setting.

Like DOOM, Heretic consists of three distinct episodes, playable in any order, the first being available as shareware. The hunt for D'Sparil begins in the City of the Damned, continues in the alternate dimension of the Hell's Maw and comes to an end in The Dome of D'Sparil. Every episode consists of nine levels, one of them a hidden one. The goal in each level is to find the exit, killing everything standing in one's way. Keys must be found and buttons pressed to advance. Enemies include gargoyles, golems, undead knights, sorcerers, ophidian beasts and more. Most enemies exist in several varieties: some have additional range attacks, others have ghost forms and are impervious to certain weapons.

The weapon arsenal is large and varied: the basic weapons are a wooden staff and the Elvenwand that shoots low-damage magic bullets. More powerful equipment must be found: the Ethereal Crossbow dispenses a spread of arrows doing high damage, but at a low firing rate. The Dragon's Claw and Hellstaff shoot with a higher frequency: the Claw hits enemies instantly, the Staff's energy bullets need to travel to them first. The Phoenix Rod fires explosive charges and must be handled with care. The Firemace unleashes steel metal projectiles that bounce across the room towards the enemy. A better melee weapon than the wooden staff are the Gauntlets of the Necromancer, which dispense deadly energy.

Heretic goes beyond DOOM in certain aspects. The engine has been enhanced with the ability to look up and down and the ability to fly, and wind currents pushing the player in (often unwanted) directions have been added. Also new is an inventory system. Many different power-ups can be collected and then be used at the correct time. These include health flasks, invisibility and invincibility upgrades, time bombs, and torches to light dark rooms.

418755.overview: An outstanding text adventure about the search for the chalice of God. The consequences to be faced if you fail in your mission are dire indeed. Are you up to the challenge?  Your travels will take you through some 140 locations and they are so detailed and well written were their descriptions that you may even enjoy wandering into a few dead ends. As Yaggra had said in the introductory text, "A degree of risk does exist, but any goal worth achieving is made the sweeter by the pleasure of the chase." This was an observation with which you surely will concur and your pleasure at reaching the end may only be tempered by the realization that there are no more places to visit or problems to solve.

418883.overview:
Amiga port of uhexen2 aka Hexen II: Hammer of Thyrion. Like the in the original, the world of Thyrion was continuously conquered by the demon brothers known as the Serpent Riders. After two of them were defeated, the oldest and most powerful of the three, Eidolon, is the only one that stands between slavery and liberation. A lone hero must first defeat his generals, the Four Horsemen of the Apocalypse, and finally bring the fight to Eidolon himself.

Hexen II is the third game in the Heretic and Hexen series. Like its predecessors, it is a medieval fantasy-themed first-person shooter. Similarly to Hexen, the player can choose between different character classes - Paladin, Crusader, Assassin, and Necromancer (four as opposed to three in Hexen). These characters have different parameters and abilities, compelling the player to use different fighting styles when controlling them. The Paladin has high vitality and focuses on melee weapons; the Crusader is a defensive character who eventually acquires healing abilities; the Assassin gains access to a critical strike skill when sneaking on enemies; and the Necromancer is physically vulnerable but is eventually able to restore his powers from fallen enemies. Each character has access to four unique weapons during the course of the game.

The player character travels to four stylistically distinct areas (medieval European, Mesoamerican, ancient Egyptian, and Greco-Roman). Each area is composed out of interconnected stages. Switch-manipulating and item-procuring puzzles must be usually solved in order to advance. It is often required to travel between stages several times in order to complete these tasks. Enemies do not respawn when the player re-enters an area.

A new feature in the game compared to its predecessors are its role-playing elements. Each character has attributes which increase when the character gains experience by defeating monsters. Characters' hit points and mana are extended gradually and permanently when leveling up. They also gain new abilities at specific levels. Weapons can be powered up by acquiring Tomes of Power, unlocking alternate (usually more damaging) firing patterns for them. Since the ranged weapons in the game are magical, they deplete the player character's blue or green mana bars when used. Like health, these can be restored by finding appropriate recovery items.

418884.overview:
An Open Source Amiga Conversion. Like the original DOS version, Hexen  is the sequel to Heretic. While the Heretic was destroying D'Sparil, the other two Serpent Riders have come to your dimension and slaughtered everyone. Or so they thought. Three humans have managed to escape with their lives and now seek vengeance against the Serpent Rider Korax who remains in their world.

Like Heretic, Hexen is a fantasy game based on an enhanced DOOM engine. All of Heretic's innovations like vertical looking, flying, and the inventory system have been carried over. The new major changes this time around are three characters for the player to choose from and the level hub system. The characters are the Fighter, the Cleric, and the Mage. Each one has four unique weapons and different levels of speed and armor.

The hub system steps away from the traditional "single levels stringed along into episodes" system which had been carried over into the FPS genre from sidescrollers and made popular by Wolfenstein 3D. In Hexen's hub system each episode is still made up of interconnected levels, but most of the levels are connected to a single "hub" level through portals. There are also portals between some of the "spoke" levels. Many of the puzzles in Hexen require travel back and forth between different levels.

Other innovations in Hexen include weather effects, jumping, earth-quakes, and destructible objects such as trees and vases. The game also includes scripted sequences created with a language called ACS, allowing for much more complex puzzles and dramatic scenes.

There are three character sets; one with 16 colours, one with 8 colours and one using plain ASCII letters. Using a supplied program, the user can create his own character sets as well. 423452.overview:
Hack is the precursor to NetHack, both members of the family of text-based Rogue-like games. Like other roguelikes, Hack is the quintessential computer role-playing game (RPG): Choose a character class and venture forth into the dungeon to fight monsters and gain treasure.

Like all descendants of Rogue, Hack is displayed from a top-down view, painted with text characters. The player ventures throughout the dungeon, visiting rooms connected by thin corridors. Gameplay is turn-based, with the turn beginning with the player's action (move, attack, eat, cast spell, etc.). Commands are mapped to various letters of the keyboard, including "i" for inventory, "e" for eat food, etc. with one exception: Attacking a monster involves running into it, so the "attack" function shares the same keys as movement.

Hack is one of the first significant deviations from Rogue, notable by the rich interaction possible in the game world: Simple actions result in complex (yet logical) reactions. For example, it is not uncommon to throw a boomerang only to miss the target and have it return to hit the player; or kill a monster that has the ability to turn you to stone as an attack, then accidentally step on its carcass on the way out and turn to stone; or having a bolt of fire from a magic wand ricochet around the room, hit the player, and cause his magic scrolls to catch on fire; etc. In addition, monsters and objects have secondary, hidden properties; for example, killing and eating a leprechaun will result in the player randomly teleporting to different locations.

423723.overview: A polish language educational quiz game focused on history, published by Techland soft in 1995. 423798.overview:
One day, you're happily walking along when you fall down a hole.
This hole leads to an old abandoned rabbit warren containing many many rabbit graves, put to rest after drowning in the Easter game. Something about your fall causes the rabbits to awaken from their graves. Your only chance for survival is to climb your way through the warren to escape back to the surface. The aim of the game is to escape from each level, and there's 68 billion possible levels! You take turns to move, and after you move, all of the rabbits will move. Make sure you look to see which way they're facing as they may move into the spot you just moved into! 
If you walk forward into a zombie rabbit your sword will kill it! 
If a rabbit walks into you.... you die....!

It's a turn-by-turn procedurally generated puzzle game with over 68 billion levels! The game features an online high score table as well as a local one
If your Amiga has an Internet connection you can submit your score from within the game (bsdsockets.library) If not, you can use the code shown and enter it on the website manually. Because all games are procedurally generated, its possible to re-play the same game, or someone else's game, and these games are shared via the high score table.

Current version is 2.21 (final).

      - up: propulsion
      - left/right : rotate
      - fire: use weapon 
      - down: change weapon 
      - down + button = hyperjump
        (...to another random position. Reduces health -1 and
        destroys active missiles and laser shots.
        So use it carefully!)

- You can play either 1 Player (against cpu) or 2 Player games. 

- Game modes are : "single fight" or "best of five"

- For 1 Player games, different difficulty levels can be chosen

458853.overview:

Hundra, Jorund's daughter, has managed to convince the gods that Loki is to blame,  but she has not succeeded in freeing her father. The verdict has been passed, and  they have no intention of backing down, although they authorize Hundra to come and rescue him. 

Aware of the difficult task, Hundra visits the old sorcerer Kaldar for guidance on the  best way to fulfill her mission. He says that if entering is difficult, leaving is even more so, and that she can only do so if she first finds the three sacred gems.

8 BITS VERSION: Hundra is a Spanish game created in 1988 by Zeus Software and published  by Dinamic. It was programmed by Ricardo Puerto with graphics by Raúl López and music and effects by Javi Cubedo.  It also features cover art by the renowned artist Luis Royo.

GOALS LEVEL 1: Find the three sacred gems and free Old Jorund.

Wanting to give more variety to the game and to pay homage to the 2nd installment of Dinamic games, I wanted to make a different second part and I thought about showing the return journey of Jorund and Hundra (aboard the Drakkar ship) to their native home, the Viking village.

GOALS LEVEL 2:  Avoid obstacles and return home.

CONTROL OF HUNDRA:

Movement - Arrow Keys / Joystick

Jump - Up Key / Joystick Up

Shoot - Fire Key 1 / Joystick Button 1

Restart Character - Fire 2 (very useful if you fall into a trap)

Return to Menu - ESC

Quit Game - F10
